name: Optimized Octant Generation
definition: An optimization for isosurface extraction on Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) data that reduces redundant computation by merging 'inner' octants into dual cells, while preserving crack-free continuity at level boundaries.
summary: Optimized Octant Generation reduces redundant computation in AMR isosurface extraction by merging inner octants into dual cells, avoiding the eightfold recomputation of shared vertex values.
